text: Based on the evidence provided, no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or more were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The data sources used include Hansen Global Forest Change and JRC Global Forest Cover 2020, which are reliable and up-to-date. However, it's important to note that changes smaller than 0.5 hectares or at the edges of the asset may not have been detected due to the resolution of the data. Therefore, we can conclude that no significant tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020.
